standard.summary: 选择 torch.compile 使用的底层后端。不同后端在速度、兼容性、调试友好度上有差异。
standard.effect: inductor（默认）= 最优化性能，生成 Triton kernel；cudagraphs = 固定形状下极快；eager = 不编译，仅用 Dynamo 追踪（调试用）；aot_eager = AOT 图捕获但不编译（调试用）。
standard.whenToUse: 生产训练用 inductor；输入形状固定时可尝试 cudagraphs 进一步提速；遇到 inductor bug 时用 eager 调试。
standard.avoidWhen: eager/aot_eager 是调试后端，不提供性能提升。

optionDescriptions.aot_eager: AOT 追一下再 eager 跑。
optionDescriptions.inductor: 常见的高性能编译后端。

standard_en.summary: Selects the backend torch.compile uses underneath. They differ in speed, compatibility and how easy they are to debug.
standard_en.effect: inductor (the default) = the best performance, generating Triton kernels; cudagraphs = extremely fast at fixed shapes; eager = no compilation, only Dynamo tracing (for debugging); aot_eager = AOT graph capture without compilation (for debugging).
standard_en.whenToUse: Use inductor for production training; try cudagraphs for extra speed when input shapes are fixed; use eager to debug an inductor bug.
standard_en.avoidWhen: eager and aot_eager are debugging backends and give no speed-up.

optionDescriptions.eager: No compilation backend at all; easy to debug.
optionDescriptions.cudagraphs: CUDA Graphs, appropriate only at fixed shapes.

advanced.principle: TorchDynamo 将 Python 计算图降级到 FX 图 → 送入后端：inductor 通过 Triton/CUDA 生成 kernel；cudagraphs 捕获 CUDA stream 命令序列实现零-overhead 重放；eager 直接执行 FX 图。
advanced.tradeoffs: cudagraphs 要求每次前向输入形状完全相同（否则需重新捕获），变长 token 场景不适用；inductor 首次编译慢但一次编译多次复用。

advanced_en.principle: TorchDynamo lowers the Python compute graph to an FX graph → handed to the backend: inductor generates kernels via Triton/CUDA; cudagraphs captures the CUDA stream command sequence for zero-overhead replay; eager executes the FX graph directly.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: cudagraphs requires identical input shapes every forward (otherwise re-capture is needed) — not applicable to variable-length tokens; inductor compiles slowly the first time but reuses the compilation thereafter.
